QuestInfo.name: Investigating Fire Raccoon Finance
QuestInfo.0: #p9120015# is waiting for you in front of Fire Raccoon Finance. Speak to him if you have any questions before entering the building.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p9120015#, there is a ledger kept on the top floor of the Fire Raccoon Finance building containing a full accounting of the organization's corruption. Acquire it and bring it to #p9120014#.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the secret ledger to #p9120014#. #p9120014# says the ledger is so big that it will take him a while to pore through.

0.0: What comes next won't be easy. You'll need to enter Fire Raccoon Finance's headquarters and make your way to the top floor.
0.1: Inside is a double-entry ledger containing a full accounting of Fire Raccoon Finance's corruption. Acquire it, and take it to #p9120014#.

yes.0: Get rid of that stupid fake scar. It's not going to help you.
yes.1: You're going to have to fight your way through that place.

no.0: I know the townspeople fear the Yakuza, but you too?

1.0: Did you bring back the secret ledger?

yes.0: This is it. Heheh. I knew from the minute I saw you I knew you'd be up to the task.
yes.1: But this ledger is huge. It's going to take a while to look through everything.

default.0: I need Fire Raccoon Finance's ledger if I'm going to take down the Yakuza.
